test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A sum of money amounts to ₹7,436 after 6 years and ₹9,460 after 10 years at the same rate of simple interest. Find the rate of interest per annum.
solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 6 years (A₆) = ₹7436

Amount after 10 years (A₁₀) = ₹9460

Time difference = 10 - 6 = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest earned in (10 - 6) = 4 years = A₁₀ - A₆

Simple interest for 4 years = 9460 - 7436 = ₹2024

Simple interest per year = 2024 / 4 = ₹506

Simple interest for 6 years = 506 × 6 = ₹3036

Principal (P) = Amount after 6 years - Simple interest for 6 years

P = 7436 - 3036 = ₹4400

Now, using the simple interest formula for 6 years:

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

3036 = (4400 × R × 6) / 100

3036 = 44 × R × 6

⇒ R = 11.5

**∴ The rate of interest per annum is 11.5%.**
